svg.text: dc43: End-to-End Governance, Storage & Telemetry Architecture
Sub-Services, Inbound Dependencies, Protocols (OTel gRPC/HTTP), Physical Tables & Upstream Feedback Loops

g.text: 1. UPSTREAM PROVENANCE & STORAGE BACKENDS (Where Contracts & Data Products Originate)
• Spark SQL: SELECT payload FROM contracts
• Local disk, Git repo, DBFS, S3, ABFS
2. INBOUND CONSUMPTION [📥 CONSUMED AT RUNTIME BY SPARK INTEGRATION]
• Schema, types, NOT NULL, PKs, Rules
• Strict: Fails pipeline on contract breach
• Split: Clean rows -> Primary Sink Table
4. dc43 GOVERNANCE CONTROL PLANE & DEDICATED SUB-SERVICES (FastAPI REST Service / In-Process Client)
• Serves ODCS contracts to integration clients
• Serves ODPS descriptors & resolves input/output port bindings
• Executes evaluation engines (Native, Great Expectations, Soda)
• Writes status, activity & metrics to GovernanceStore
• Triggered on schema drift when draft_on_violation=True
• Creates incremented draft ODCS contract in ContractStore
• Prerequisites: Databricks SQL Warehouse DSN + ALTER/TAG rights
• Executes ALTER TABLE SET TBLPROPERTIES & SET TAGS
Control plane tables: Authoritative contracts, state snapshots, and version links
→ Lu par les lecteurs pour autoriser la lecture
⚙️ CONSUMED BY CONTROL PLANE (Prevents Silent Drift)
💥 SI ABSENT : DÉRIVE SILENCIEUSE NON DÉTECTÉE (Incompatibilité de version invisible !)
PostgreSQL/MySQL (SQLAlchemy), Delta Lake / Unity Catalog (PySpark), Local Filesystem (JSON)
Data plane telemetry: Fine-grained time-series metrics, regulatory logs & OTel spans
• OpenTelemetry: OTLP gRPC (port 4317) & OTLP HTTP/protobuf / JSON (port 4318 /v1/traces)
• OpenLineage: HTTP POST JSON (Spec 2.0.2) to Marquez / DataHub / Collibra
💥 SI NON ÉMIS : AUCUNE ALERTE TEMPS RÉEL (Incidents & pannes de prod silencieux !)
OTLP gRPC/HTTP Protobuf & JSON, OpenLineage REST (POST /api/v1/lineage), SQLAlchemy / Spark SQL
6A. ACTIONABLE GOVERNANCE PLATFORMS (Beyond a Passive DB)
🔄 POINT DE DÉPART DE LA BOUCLE D'ÉVOLUTION DE SCHÉMA (BOUCLE 1)
Human Steward Draft Approval Workflow (Collibra / Purview / DataHub):
• Data Stewards valident/ajustent la proposition de draft ODCS v1.1.0 générée par ContractDrafter.
• Une fois approuvé, le contrat est promu comme NOUVELLE VERSION ACTIVE dans le ContractStore (Tier 1) !
Active Access Control (ABAC) via Unity Catalog Tags:
• Tags Unity Catalog (dc43_status='block') bloquent immédiatement les outils BI et requêtes ad-hoc.
• Déblocage automatique dès que les données redeviennent conformes (ok).
6B. ACTIONABLE OBSERVABILITY & INCIDENT WORKFLOWS (Beyond a Passive DB)
Datadog / Prometheus + Grafana / Marquez / EventBridge / Jira
Trigger PagerDuty / Slack P0 alerts immediately when dc43.validation.ok == false or error threshold is breached.
Visualise l'arbre d'impact et met automatiquement en pause les DAGs Airflow / Dagster dépendants.
Webhooks ouvrent automatiquement les tickets Jira et déclenchent le reprocessing de quarantaine.
